full_prompt_en: The image is a square natural-history watercolor illustration of white water birds nestled among broad leaves and pink lotus blossoms on warm cream paper. The page background remains pale and lightly textured, with faint curved linework visible around the outside of the dense central growth. In the upper center, a large layered red-pink lotus flower rises above the group, its translucent petals darkening toward their folded bases. A broad blue-green leaf sits behind it at the upper right, while upright seedpods and slender stems extend toward the top edge. On the left, a large white bloom and a closed round bud glow softly against overlapping gray-green leaves. At the far right, a pale pink bloom opens beside another dark-edged leaf, and a smaller pink-and-cream flower sits just above the birds. In the lower middle, two white water birds rest close together among the foliage. The left bird shows a long curved neck, dark eye, and a partly open reddish bill pointing left; its white feathers carry fine gray contours and soft blue shadows. The second bird is partly hidden by blossoms and leaves, its head and folded wing visible behind the first. Large rounded leaves fill the lower foreground, including a blue-gray disc near the center and several olive-green forms with dark veins and softly browned edges. Shallow water or dark ground appears only in small fragments beneath them, so the scene reads as a clustered study rather than a wide landscape. Diffuse daylight from above and left warms the pale petals and bird feathers, while the folds between leaves retain cool gray-green shade. Delicate pencil-like lines define stems, veins, beaks, and petal edges; transparent color washes and subtle paper grain soften the broader areas. The arrangement is dense in the center but leaves small pale margins around the growth. The overall composition balances white feathers and blossoms with red-pink accents and cool broad leaves, creating a quiet, intricate study of overlapping natural forms.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形自然史水彩插画，白色水鸟栖在宽叶和粉色莲花之间，底色是暖奶油色纸面。纸页背景保持浅淡并略带纹理，密集植物外围还能看见淡淡的弯曲线描。上方中央，一朵层层叠叠的红粉色莲花升出画面，半透明花瓣在折叠根部渐深。右上方一片宽大的蓝绿色叶子立在花后，直立的莲蓬与细茎伸向顶边。左侧，一朵大白花和一枚未开的圆润花苞在交叠的灰绿叶前柔和发亮。最右边一朵浅粉色花开在深边叶旁，另一朵较小的粉色与奶油色花位于水鸟上方。中下部两只白色水鸟紧挨着歇在叶丛里。左边那只露出弯长脖颈、深色眼睛和朝左微张的红色嘴，白羽带细灰色轮廓与柔蓝阴影。第二只被花叶遮住一部分，头与收拢的翅膀在第一只身后可见。宽大圆叶填满下方前景，包括中央附近的蓝灰圆叶和几片带深叶脉、边缘略褐的橄榄绿叶。浅水或深色地面只在叶下小片露出，所以场景像密集的观察图，而非宽广风景。漫射日光从上方偏左进入，温暖浅色花瓣与羽毛，叶片间的折叠处则保有冷灰绿色阴影。类似铅笔的细线确定茎、叶脉、鸟嘴和花瓣边缘；透明的色层与轻微纸纹柔化宽大区域。组合集中在中央，植物外围仍留少量浅色边。整体构图以白羽和白花平衡红粉色强调及冷调宽叶，形成安静而繁密的自然形体交叠画面。
style_prompt_en: Watercolor and fine drawing combine transparent layered washes with precise, hairline details on a warm lightly grained ground. Blue-gray and sage green occupy broad overlapping areas, while cream and rose-red accents create a compact luminous center. Rounded forms interlock densely, leaving a narrow pale margin and occasional openings that keep the layers legible. Edges vary from crisp ink-like contours at small features to feathered, pigment-soft transitions across larger washes. Subtle granulation and slight browning at the outer edges give the surface an aged, tactile character. Diffuse light makes pale areas glow gently, with cool shaded pockets between the overlapping layers rather than hard cast shadows. The overall treatment is intricate, calm, and delicately colored, relying on measured detail within a dense organic rhythm.
style_prompt_zh: 水彩与细线描把透明层叠色洗和精确如发丝的细节放在温暖、轻带颗粒的底色上。蓝灰与鼠尾草绿占据宽大交叠区域，奶油色和玫瑰红强调形成紧凑明亮的中心。圆润形体密集咬合，留下狭窄浅色边和偶尔的开口，使层次仍清楚。边缘从细部墨线般清脆的轮廓，变为宽阔色洗里颜料羽化的柔软过渡。细微颗粒与外围轻微褐化赋予表面旧而可感的性质。漫射光让浅色区域温柔发亮，交叠层之间是冷色内凹阴影，而非坚硬投影。整体处理繁密、安静且色彩精巧，在密集有机节奏中安排有分寸的细节。
theme_en: White water birds nestled among broad leaves and pink lotus blossoms
theme_zh: 白色水鸟栖在宽叶与粉色莲花之间
name: Edward Julius Detmold
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
